defects: The partial-derivative hypothesis is unfolded into a raw coefficient identity (coeff (n + single i 1) f * ((n + single i 1) i : R) = coeff (n + single i 1) g * ((n + single i 1) i : R)) rather than stated as the direct power-series equality `pderiv R i f = pderiv R i g` used in gold; this is mathematically equivalent via the coefficient formula for `pderiv` and coefficient-extensionality of power series, but is a definitional unfolding rather than a mere notational/order variation, so it does not count as a strict match.
